text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum today with a 1.8% gain versus 0.3%, while altcoins show mixed momentum—SOL surges 9.2% but most others lag. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and rising indicates risk appetite is strengthening, though Bitcoin's 59.2% dominance suggests investors are consolidating into the largest assets rather than chasing smaller-cap opportunities. At $99B in daily volume, market participation remains solid but not euphoric, pointing to cautious accumulation rather than panic buying or selling.
